source.text: Rupert Julian (25 January 1879 – 27 December 1943) was a New Zealand cinema actor, director, writer and producer.
source.title: Rupert Julian

source.text: Three Faces East is a 1926 silent film directed by Rupert Julian and starring Jetta Goudal and Clive Brook. It is based on a popular Broadway play about spies during World War I. It was refilmed in sound in 1930. The story's action takes place in France and Britain. This film is listed as surviving in Bois d'Arcy in France.
source.title: Three Faces East (1926 film)
